mathematics.assertion_tested: Direct exact differentiation of the unitary-gauge ADM action gives block diagonal Hessian with five shear, one trace and one scalar entry; exact ranks on its eight degeneracy strata; double-degenerate flat homogeneous constant-K branch requires rho+p=0.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational function algebra over real symbols, with square-root tensor basis normalization; SymPy formal functions K and J
mathematics.conventions: Signature (-+++), Kij=(dot hij-L_shift hij)/(2N), F=1/(16 pi G)>0, b=2-K_B, c13=c1+c3, c14=c1+c4; positive lapse and spatial metric; matter minimally coupled
inputs: Section 2 action and definitions; generic local spatial data; smooth K and J at evaluation point
non_claims: No full Hamiltonian constraint algebra or DOF count
FLRW restriction applies only on the specified degenerate branches
